remarks:
Welcome home where timeless character meets the laid-back lifestyle in the Village of Angola! Set on a spacious corner lot in Village and the lakefront Town of Evans! This charming home offers warmth, character, and simple small town living. Stunning natural woodwork, soaring 10-foot ceilings, hardwood and luxury vinyl flooring create a warm, atmosphere throughout. The spacious living room flows into the formal dining room, where a fireplace adds the perfect touch of character for cozy dinners and gatherings.
The first floor offers flexibility with an additional office or bedroom and a beautifully updated bathroom, creating potential for a convenient first-floor office or potential future in-law setup. Upstairs, you'll find additional bedrooms along with an abundance of closet and storage space.
Outside, the oversized corner lot gives you room to spread out, while the extra side yard offers an ideal space for boat or RV parking—perfect for embracing the nearby lake lifestyle. A 2-car garage with opener and remote, full basement, central air conditioning, vinyl siding, and a new 2026 hot water tank add everyday convenience.
This location is hard to beat! Leave the car at home and take a walk into the heart of the Village for the movie theater, restaurants, library, local shops, and summer concerts. Spend your warmer days enjoying nearby beaches, Sturgeon Point Marina, Evangola State Park, and all the recreation the Lake Erie shoreline has to offer—all while being approximately 20 minutes from Buffalo.
Whether you're searching for a character-filled year-round home or your own escape near the lake, this home offers the space, charm, and location to make it your own!
